svg.title: External issues and pull requests opened each week in ARC-1
svg.desc: September 23 through November 22, 2026. 36 contributors opened 72 issues and 55 pull requests. Weekly counts, issues then pull requests: Sep 23 to 27: 3 and 3. Sep 28: 8 and 6. Oct 5: 13 and 8. Oct 12: 9 and 3. Oct 19: 14 and 9. Oct 26: 13 and 13. Nov 2: 4 and 5. Nov 9: 3 and 1. Nov 16: 5 and 7.
